build.buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction && npm ci && npm run build && php artisan config:cache && php artisan route:cache && php artisan view:cache

deploy.startCommand: php artisan storage:link || true && (php artisan app:restore-state deploy-state/state.bin || true) && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
